description: Estimate a severance package: weeks of pay per year of service times years of service times weekly pay, with an optional plan minimum and maximum, plus unused PTO paid out, employer-paid health coverage and other lump sums. Use it for an employer budgeting an exit or an employee checking an offer; every input is the plan's own terms, because US federal law sets no severance formula. Use cost_of_a_bad_hire for the all-in cost of a failed hire instead. Amounts are before tax.

annual_salary_usd.description: Annual salary in US dollars; weekly pay is salary divided by 52.

health_coverage_months.description: Months of health coverage the employer pays. Default 0.

maximum_weeks.description: The plan's cap in weeks of pay, if any. Trims a long tenure down to this figure; if below the minimum, the cap wins.

minimum_weeks.description: The plan's minimum severance in weeks of pay, if any. Lifts a short tenure up to this figure.

monthly_health_premium_usd.description: Monthly cost of that coverage in US dollars. Default 0.

other_lump_sums_usd.description: Any other lump sums, such as a pro-rated bonus, in US dollars. Default 0.

unused_pto_days.description: Unused PTO days paid out, valued at salary divided by 260 working days. Default 0.

weeks_of_pay_per_year.description: Weeks of pay the plan gives for each year of service. Many plans use 1 or 2; there is no legal standard.

years_of_service.description: Years of service, decimals allowed (for example 4.5).

name: severance_pay

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.
